en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a riverside or canal-side promenade labeled in German. It shows an elegant historic building complex with ornate roofs and a tall tower with a spire, reflected in the calm water in the foreground. A small bridge crosses the water on the left, and a walled walkway with trees lines the bank on the right. The printed caption at the top left reads "Bilin. Am Bielaquai."
